If you love sorting puzzle games, you need to download this. It is so fun and relaxing.

author: rent399
title: Don’t bother
content:
If I could give zero stars, I would. I’ve contacted customer support multiple times because I paid for coins that were never added to my account, and I’ve also found unexplained charges for purchases I never made. My bank has already filed a report regarding the unauthorized charges.

The gameplay itself is extremely misleading and feels designed to force players into spending money. Between levels, you may win 50 coins, but the cost to “clean up” after a level starts around 900 coins and increases to 1,900 coins if you don’t have other power-ups available. At that point, you’re either forced to pay more money or restart the level entirely.

I’ve spent well over $200 just to reach level 337, and it becomes obvious very quickly that progressing in this game requires constant spending. A game should be enjoyable and fair, not structured in a way that pressures players into paying just to continue.

Save your time, money, and energy for a game that doesn’t rely on endless purchases to make progress.

author: rent399
title: Don’t bother
content:
If I could give zero stars, I would. I’ve contacted customer support multiple times because I paid for coins that were never added to my account, and I’ve also found unexplained charges for purchases I never made. My bank has already filed a report regarding the unauthorized charges.

The gameplay itself is extremely misleading and feels designed to force players into spending money. Between levels, you may win 50 coins, but the cost to “clean up” after a level starts around 900 coins and increases to 1,900 coins if you don’t have other power-ups available. At that point, you’re either forced to pay more money or restart the level entirely.

I’ve spent well over $200 just to reach level 337, and it becomes obvious very quickly that progressing in this game requires constant spending. A game should be enjoyable and fair, not structured in a way that pressures players into paying just to continue.

Save your time, money, and energy for a game that doesn’t rely on endless purchases to make progress.
